note: The V4 pre-dev note, machine half (docs/V4_FEASIBILITY.md, sections 3-5b). Inputs fixed 2026-11-19: bundle = Kaggle notebook notebook8c927d8f13 output; bal archive = Daggerabuse/osv5m-ft-archive-bal (539,906 images, 25 parts, 27.531 GB). v4_train refuses to run unless this file is committed and unmodified; any change after a run starts changes the run key (a fresh run). Confirmed 2026-11-19: the seed-2 replicate (job 6) uses seed 43; the control's (job 7) head lr = 10 x that backbone's selected adapter lr (= its 50K full run's head lr).
gpu_rule: job k: streetclip on cuda:(k mod 2), clip_l14_336 on the other GPU (decision 7)

train.schedule: linear warmup, then cosine to 0 (train.lr_factor); the scheduler step is skipped when an fp16 overflow skips the optimizer step
train.augmentation: train.train_view (V1: no flip, no hue), seeded by (seed, epoch, bal_rank)

evals.intermediate: 5K dev_unseen at steps total//3 and 2*total//3, full and control runs only (diagnostic only; short runs have none, as budgeted)
evals.diagnostic: 2K dev_unseen after every epoch boundary, in the 50K full run (job 4) only: diagnostic only, never used for selection, stopping or checkpoint choice
evals.final: all of dev_unseen (selection) and dev_seen (diagnostic), at the final checkpoint

selection.metric: mean GeoScore of the top-1 cell centroid
